summary: The supplied synthetic challenge lists approximate Finnish field-loss reference rates of 1.1 kg P/ha/year and 15 kg N/ha/year. These are not catchment-specific calibrated coefficients.

title: Nitrogen and phosphorus balance — Luke Food Facts
summary: Nutrient balance compares application and crop uptake; it indicates risk but does not directly quantify short-term loading to water. The pilot does not equate application or a balance with delivered load. No numeric coefficient is taken from this page.

title: Can water pollution from farming be reduced? — Finnish Environment Institute
summary: Bare soil, meltwater, flooding and autumn rain affect agricultural nutrient transport; erosion transports particle-bound P. Annual rainfall alone omits important processes. This supports process separation, not the pilot's numerical multipliers or delivery curve.
